method.gldas_evapotranspiration: Evap_tavg (kg m-2 s-1) multiplied by 10800 seconds per 3-hour interval, then summed by UTC calendar day; 1 kg m-2 water equivalent = 1 mm.
method.gldas_root_moisture: RootMoist_inst (kg m-2) summarized by UTC day using mean/min/max; retained in kg m-2 (numerically equivalent to mm water equivalent).
method.gpm_precipitation: GPM_3IMERGM v07 time-mean rate (mm/hr) from 2023 GeoTIFF. Annualized equivalent = mean rate × 24 × 365; this is not a directly summed daily/monthly accumulation product.
method.noaa_reference: NOAA GHCN-Daily is retained as an external reference only; it is not NASA data and is not mixed into NASA-only indicator results.

warnings: GLDAS point series represents one model grid point near 30.9 N, 31.0 E, not an area-average over the Nile Delta.
The GPM GeoTIFF is GPM_3IMERGM monthly v07 and stores a temporal-mean rate in mm/hr; annualized values are rate-equivalent estimates.
NOAA station temperature is an external comparison source with incomplete Alexandria coverage; it must not be presented as NASA data.
No NDVI or MODIS LST input files were supplied in this data batch.
The 2023 record supports seasonal description within one year, not long-term climate trend or future forecast claims.
